Monty Hall Simulator

Simulate the Monty Hall problem: compare win rates of staying vs switching over thousands of trials.

33.4%
Win % if you STAY
66.6%
Win % if you SWITCH

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the number of trials and doors.
  2. Press Run simulation.
  3. Compare the stay vs switch win percentages and bars.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why does switching win more?

Your first pick is right only 1/3 of the time. When it’s wrong (2/3), the host’s reveal leaves the prize behind the other door — so switching wins 2/3.

Does more doors change the answer?

Staying always wins 1/D. Switching to a random other unopened door wins (D−1)/(D(D−2)) — still better than staying.

Is the simulation truly random?

Yes — prize door, initial pick, host’s reveal and the switch target are all drawn uniformly at random each trial.
